strategy: <random | stratified | group | stratified-group | temporal | grouped-temporal | predefined>
rationale: <why this split represents how the model will be used>
unit_of_independence: <row, customer, patient, lesion, document source, store, ...>

temporal.forecast_origins: <rule or list of origins, or null>
temporal.gap: <embargo between training labels and evaluation, or null>
temporal.label_maturity_rule: <rows allowed in training at each origin, or null>

seed: <integer used by the split procedure, or null>
procedure: <script path and revision that produces the assignments>

assignments.path: <file mapping row or entity IDs to train / validation / fold / test>

checks.group_overlap_across_splits: <count and command; must be zero only when the evaluation represents unseen entities>
checks.duplicate_overlap_across_splits: <count of established duplicates of the same item across splits, and how identity was established, or not applicable>
